question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

PRACTICAL
solution:
The correct answer is **Applicable.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Practical** is an **adjective** that means concerned with actual doing__.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows -
 __
 
• **Applicable - **Relevant to somebody/something. किसी या कुछ के लिए महत्वपूर्ण __**I**
 
• **Theoretical - **Based on ideas and principles. विचारों और सिद्धांतों के आधार पर।
 
• **Everlasting - **Continue forever, Never changing. हमेशा के लिए जारी , कभी नहीं बदलने वाला ।
 
• **Sensible -** Able to make good judgments based on reasons. कारणों के आधार पर अच्छे निर्णय लेने में सक्षम।

 ​
 
 

*​From the above meanings, it is clear that Applicable** **is the correct synonym for the word **Practical.​***
